assumptions: NREL 5 MW reference chord/span scaled to scene radius; not the actual turbine blade specification.
Fixed polar tables at their reference conditions; no Reynolds-number correction or dynamic stall.
Straight rigid blades; reference sweep/prebend, section pitching moment and flexibility omitted.
Prescribed TSR=7 based on 10 m/s inlet, zero pitch; no shaft inertia, generator or controller model.
Ct is not used for actuator-line loading: thrust and torque arise from section lift/drag.
Moment-corrected Gaussian kernel sigma=sqrt(2)*h, truncated at 3 sigma, can have signed weights near masked geometry. Coarse-grid trial, no grid-independent accuracy claim.
Initial field transferred from 600 s ADM run; new ALM trial time begins at zero.
No water, waves, floating motion, moorings or electrical power prediction.
